annotations.text:
Home page — zones 1-10 of the Design Brief (INSP-EFQatar-DESIGN-HomeAndMember-v0.1), visitor-not-signed-in state.

Brand: accent #4B1527, sampled from Logo.jpeg in the project folder. The EF mark here is a typeset stand-in — production needs EF's vector artwork (DQ-01).

Every dashed grey chip is a fact EF has not supplied yet, left visible rather than invented: the four proof figures (DQ-04), officer names, venues, contact details, the affiliation mark (DQ-07). Announcement, event and benefit copy is sample text pending content owners (DQ-08, DQ-11).

My EF — zones 1-9 of the brief, shown in the EXPIRING SOON state on both widths, so the two agree.

That state was chosen over Active because it exercises the whole hierarchy: status card, one 'needs attention' item with money attached, and a single primary action (Renew membership) that everything else drops below.

Four states remain to be designed — pending approval, active, lapsed, suspended (brief §7.3). Mobile resolves at 390px with the section rail as a visible list, 48px hit targets, and no fake status bar. Member data is sample.
